context.transcript:
You can use your credit card to withdraw money from most banks in Germany.
A. The train is convenient.
B. Please sign the receipt.
C. Are there any service fees?
context.transcript_translation:
你可以在德国大多数银行用信用卡取钱。
A. 这趟火车很方便。
B. 请签署收据。
C. 有服务费吗？

items.question: You can use your credit card to withdraw money from most banks in Germany.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“You can use your credit card to withdraw money from most banks in Germany.”，自然应答是“Are there any service fees?”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：C（Are there any service fees?）。
